task: 12. Validate realtime event delivery and recovery
environment: deterministic in-memory realtime transport; repository source and migration inspection

checks.name: authenticated private subscription
checks.details: Authorized tenant subscriptions succeed; cross-tenant subscription is denied.

checks.name: tenant and run scoping
checks.details: Tenant-a events reach only tenant-a; tenant-b receives no tenant-a event.

checks.name: event shape and ordering/deduplication
checks.details: Metadata-only events carry tenant/run/table/event/sequence; duplicate and stale hints are ignored while authoritative state remains current.

checks.name: terminal-state visibility
checks.details: A completed run with assigned=5 and delivered=5 is visible after reconciliation.

checks.name: disconnect/reconnect recovery
checks.details: A terminal event missed while disconnected is recovered by authoritative refetch after reconnect; poll_calls=0.

checks.name: cleanup
checks.details: Synthetic run, event log, tenant subscription, and connected channel are removed.

checks.name: portal/migration contract
checks.details: Source asserts setAuth, private crm tenant channel, reconcile refresh, cache invalidation, no setInterval, channel removal, and member-gated realtime policy.

checks.name: deployed or production realtime
checks.details: No approved isolated staging target or production connection was supplied; no remote realtime service was contacted.

cleanup: PASS: in-memory fixtures and subscriptions were removed by the test; no external resources were created.
